title.narrative: Solomon Islands - Bina Harbour Project Management Office

description.narrative: On request by the Solomon Islands government New Zealand will fund a Bina Harbour Project Office to plan, conduct and facilitate work required to progress a Tuna Processing Plant and accompanying infrastructure at Bina Harbour, in Malaita Province. This includes conducting the necessary technical analysis, design and preparatory work to progress the project.
